scheme.name: Bradshaw Versioning
scheme.cutoverNote: Earlier private development releases are retained as metadata only. Public source starts at the clean baseline commit.
scheme.admission: Admission time is when a push first brought the commit to origin/main. Commits in one push are numbered parent before child.
scheme.registryCommits: Every commit on main gets a number, including commits that only update this registry. A registry update cannot know its own commit SHA, so it is recorded by the next update; until then the newest commit on main is assigned but not yet listed.
scheme.deployment: Versions identify source commits only. Deployment records in this public registry begin with public source.
scheme.conformance: Single-writer registry kept in Git by the release coordinator (not an atomic service); admission times come from the coordinator's push log.

revisions.change: Year mode changed from one-based to zero-based (origin year 2026, America/Phoenix, calendar months unchanged).
revisions.note: The one-based numbers 1.10.1 to 1.10.11 assigned earlier on 2026-10-29 were superseded by 0.10.1 to 0.10.11 for the same commits, before any deployment. Recorded here rather than changed silently, as the specification requires.
